## 4. Feature Coverage Checklist

### R1. Session Completion Immediate Reactivity & State Synchronization
- [x] **Store Synchronous Mutation**: `addSession` immediately updates `useSessionStore.getState().sessions` without reload.
- [x] **Immediate Win/Loss Recalculation**: Adding a session recalculates player match counts, wins, losses, and win rates in memory immediately.
- [x] **Streak Reactivity**: `calculatePlayerStreaks` and `calculateLongestWinStreak` reflect the newly completed match without page refresh.
- [x] **Reactive Store Queries**: `getSessionsByPlayer` and `getSessionsByGame` immediately include the new match sorted in reverse-chronological order.
- [x] **Same-Day Chronological Integrity**: Matches played on the same calendar date preserve deterministic ordering and accurate streak calculations.
- [x] **Guest Player Resilience**: Guest / one-off players not registered in `usePlayerStore` do not cause null pointer exceptions during session queries, streak calculations, or leaderboard aggregations.
- [x] **Smart Merge Non-Destructive Pull**: Local sessions are preserved alongside incoming remote sessions during `bulkAddSessions` sync merges.
- [x] **Detailed Breakdown vs Simple Scoring**: Sessions with 11-category score matrices (e.g. Great Western Trail) and simple score entries coexist seamlessly in statistics calculations.
- [x] **Dynamic Leaderboard Threshold**: Dynamic 5% qualification threshold formula (`calculateMinRequiredPlays`) dynamically qualifies and unqualifies players based on group session count.
- [x] **Game Night Multi-Match Scenario**: Exact mathematical verification for a 4-player group across 3 distinct games, validating Win Rate, Wooden Spoon, Runner-Up, and Head-to-Head metrics.
- [x] **Edge Case & Mutation Safety**: Negative scores, cooperative ties, Unicode strings, `<script>` tags, update, and deletion operations maintain complete data fidelity.
